narrative.overview: The visual design system for Sai Rudra Motors embodies The Precision Depot HUD—where heavy-duty automotive trade authority intersects with Apple Keynote glassmorphism, floating HUD telemetry, and aerodynamic fluid curves.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-engine Light (Electric Cobalt) and Dark (Obsidian Theatre) operating modes
Fluid aerodynamic SVG wave ribbons replacing flat divider lines
Pure white showcase pedestals isolating official brand logos
Zero public price display across all screens
3D levitation float physics and specular glare sheen sweeps

rules.name: The Zero-Price Rule
rules.body: No price numerals, currency symbols, or rate tags may appear on any public-facing screen.

rules.name: The Genuine Pedestal Rule
rules.body: Every authorized manufacturer brand logo rests on an isolated, immaculate pure-white showcase pedestal with unified contrast.

rules.name: The Aerodynamic Curve Rule
rules.body: Hard straight-edge dividers are forbidden between major sections; fluid SVG wave ribbons govern transitions.

dos: Do maintain pure white pedestal backgrounds for all manufacturer logos
Do route part and stock inquiries to WhatsApp with pre-filled vehicle details
Do preserve high contrast across Light and Obsidian Dark modes
Do use super-ellipse squircles (20px to 28px) and aerodynamic wave dividers
donts: Don't display price numbers or currency symbols anywhere on public screens
Don't use generic corporate buzzwords or ungrounded marketing claims
Don't introduce flat 1px horizontal lines to divide sections
Don't use low-contrast text on workshop touch interfaces
